offers_products.reason: Sells food, drinks and baby back ribs, plus packaged liquor at Big Daddy's Wine & Liquors stores.

offers_services.reason: Restaurants and bars provide table service, hospitality, takeout and dining experiences to guests.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Diners and shoppers at its restaurants, sports bars and liquor stores are individuals and families.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to walk-in diners and liquor shoppers; no business or government buyers are mentioned.

recurring_revenue.reason: Repeat local customers buy meals and drinks often, supported by a rewards program and Flan Club.

cyclical_demand.reason: Dining out and bar visits are discretionary and easily cut in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Meals and drinks are small, frequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for food, drink and restaurant venues, not mainly for staff expertise.

large_customers.reason: Customers are households and individual diners.

asset_heavy.reason: Runs over 20 restaurants plus liquor stores; growth needs significant property and build-out investment.
